description: Export a SwOS switch's configuration as one YAML document: system settings (including management access), every port's name, enabled state and VLAN settings, the VLAN table (full SwOS) and SNMP. The SNMP community is never exported. The document is the input format of apply_swos_config, so it doubles as a backup you can read and diff.

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: get_swos_config
title: Get SwOS Config
